create_CppInputOutputEvaluator: create a CppInputOutputEvaluator instance to compile and evaluate C++ programs against expected I/O outputs
run_check_outputs: run C++ code against a list of inputs and outputs to verify correctness and count failures
compile_cpp_program: compile a C++ source file into an executable binary using g++ with a configurable timeout
process_cpp_code: process and detokenize C++ code using the CppProcessor to prepare it for compilation
review_CppInputOutputEvaluator_class: review the CppInputOutputEvaluator class that extends InputOutputEvaluator for C++ language-specific compilation and evaluation
